params.body:
Removes duplicates. Behaviour stays the same.

- `parseLLMJson` existed four times (classify, discover, enrich, suggest). The copies differed only in which objects they keep when repairing broken output. It now lives in `packages/core/llm-json.mjs`, with that choice as a parameter (`isAnswer` per caller). ingest-report expects an object rather than an array and keeps its own parser.
  - One small difference: every caller now also tries parsing from the first `[` when a sentence precedes the array. Only suggest did that before; the others recovered in the repair step anyway.
- `tagIds` (three times) and the local `ids()` in query-endpoint are replaced by `refIds` in `core/concept-id.mjs`. `conceptRefId` was the same function as `unwrapRef` and is gone.
- New: `test/llm-json.test.mjs` with 6 tests. The full suite passes: 939 tests, no undefined names.
params.title: One parser for model JSON, one reader for reference ids
